findings.title: Worker dashboard exposes community shift IDs and dates to staff outside the vacancy's audience.
findings.scenario: Ben is Tom's favourite locum and should only be offered favourite-locum shifts, not Tom's internal staff vacancies. The pharmacist dashboard counts and returns a FULL_PART_TIME vacancy to Ben as a community opportunity, including its identifier and date. The normal worker shift listing correctly excludes it.
findings.test_needed: Ben is an accepted LOCUM member only. Tom creates a FULL_PART_TIME internal pharmacist shift; GET /api/v1/dashboard/pharmacist/?workspace=internal&pharmacy_id=... must exclude its ID and count; Omar (accepted FULL_TIME) must see it.

owner_question.question: Should favourite locum Ben see counts, dates or IDs of Tom's internal FULL_PART_TIME staff vacancies?
options: No: use the same audience filter as internal shift browsing
Only show aggregated counts, not identifiers or dates
Yes: keep current community opportunity listing

findings.title: Mobile dashboards label all-time drafted invoice value as this month's income.
findings.scenario: Sara issued an invoice in January, then another in October. The October pharmacist dashboard labels the sum of both invoices 'Total Income This Month', and even counts unsent draft invoices. The backend returns all-time billed amounts without a date or paid-status filter; the other-staff mobile dashboard uses the same label.
findings.test_needed: Sara has an old invoice, this-month sent invoice and an unsent draft; load pharmacist dashboard and assert a clearly defined monthly income metric excludes last month and drafts, while all-time billed metric remains separately labelled.

owner_question.question: What should Sara's 'Income This Month' tile count?
options: Only money actually received during the current calendar month
Invoices issued this month, labelled 'This Month Invoiced'
All-time invoice totals, but relabel them accurately

findings.title: Ethical stock imports can still be committed after the inventory write feature is switched off.
findings.scenario: Tom stages an ethical stock CSV while the inventory feature is available. An administrator disables ethical inventory writes to stop unsafe stock changes. Tom can still invoke the import-commit endpoint, which changes stock quantities and creates stock-movement records without checking the disabled feature flag.
findings.test_needed: Stage a valid import as a verified entitled owner with ETHICAL_INVENTORY_ENABLED=True; disable it before POST /api/v1/ethical/inventory/imports/{pk}/commit/; expect 503 and no EthicalStockLot/Movement changes. Positive flag-true commit still succeeds.

owner_question.question: When ethical inventory writes are disabled, should a previously staged import still update stock?
options: No: block every stock-mutating endpoint including commit
Allow viewing staged rows but require explicit re-enable to commit
Allow previously staged imports to commit after writes are disabled
